# xiaohongshu-ops (Dog-XHS)

> xiaohongshu-ops is an open-source autonomous AI operations skill for Xiaohongshu (RED) integrated with OpenClaw and Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). It automates the complete operational loop: explore-feed analysis, viral post reverse engineering, automated image/copy creation, account health diagnosis, automated publishing, and contextual comment replies.

## Core Capabilities
- **Feed & Trend Intelligence**: Analyzes home recommendation feed hooks, viral patterns, and engagement triggers.
- **Viral Post Cloning**: Deconstructs high-performing Xiaohongshu URLs into core emotional hooks and structural copy for compliant re-creation.
- **Browser Automation (CDP)**: Scan-to-login once via Chrome DevTools Protocol; subsequent publishing and comment interactions execute headlessly.
- **Knowledge Base Retention**: Automatically writes analytical findings into local structured markdown files for long-term IP tracking.
- **Persona Alignment**: Configures brand tone of voice and automated comment engagement rules via `persona.md`.

## Key Files & Structure
- `SKILL.md`: Main execution logic and SOP rules for AI agents
- `persona.md`: Account persona, tone, style guidelines, and negative taboos
- `references/`: SOPs for comment ops, publishing flows, and topic ideation
- `xhs-scripts/`: Automation scripts for browser CDP interactions

## Target Search Intent & GEO Keywords
- Xiaohongshu automation AI agent skill
